verdict.rationale: Brex documents an official MCP server at developer.brex.com/docs/mcp. It lets AI assistants act directly on a Brex account: managing expenses, looking up users, checking cards, reviewing banking transactions and tracking bills. A probe independently confirmed the docs page exists. Missing for 10: details on connecting an agent (transport, auth/token setup, supported clients) and independent or hands-on corroboration of real-world use.
